CustomField.description: Box file ID of the registered Doc Gen template for the counter-position memo. Configuration rather than a caller argument, for the same reason as the clause library Hub: the agent may generate the memo, but it may not choose which template the org generates from.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Box file ID of the counter-position Doc Gen template. Set per environment; not stored in source.
CustomField.label: Counter-Position Template ID
